title: Heels or No Entry
summary: A rooftop bouncer recites the door policy while the skyline burns. She produces emergency stilettos. The kick arrives after Approved.
visualArc: Velvet rope + burning skyline → closed list → stilettos from the purse → she changes shoes → inside like Tuesday → Approved on the click.

segments.label: Rope, ash, skyline
segments.onScreen: Rooftop club entrance, velvet rope, bouncer, city burning behind glass, ash.
segments.lyrics: Heels or no entry. / I don't care if the sky is on fire.
segments.musicCue: 98 BPM slow disco, no kick yet, ash as room tone
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Photoreal 2.39:1 rooftop nightclub entrance at night, red velvet rope on chrome stanchions, stone-faced bouncer in a black suit, city skyline burning orange behind floor-to-ceiling glass, ash drifting, mirrorball light spilling from the door, high contrast, dark glamour, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 12-second locked rooftop entrance. Ash drifts. Bouncer does not look at the fire. Photoreal.

segments.label: The list is closed
segments.onScreen: Bouncer with a closed clipboard; ash on the stanchion; sirens in the glass.
segments.lyrics: The rope is still velvet. The list is still closed. / I am not a metaphor. I am the door.
segments.musicCue: Dry analog bass enters; still no kick on policy lines
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Medium shot of a bouncer holding a closed clipboard list, ash on the velvet rope, sirens reflected in the glass, he does not look at the fire, cinematic, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 26-second medium. Clipboard stays closed. Photoreal deadpan.

segments.label: Emergency stilettos
segments.onScreen: Soot-stained gown; compact purse; stilettos still in tissue.
segments.lyrics: Heels or no entry / The room is still open / Approved —
segments.musicCue: Chorus; kick withheld until the click
segments.grokImaginePrompt: A woman in a soot-stained evening gown opening a small purse to produce a pair of emergency stilettos still in tissue paper, rooftop club, burning city bokeh, photoreal, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 22-second purse open. Tissue. No wink. Photoreal.

segments.label: She changes shoes
segments.onScreen: Low: hem, bare feet into black stilettos; bouncer's shoes unmoving.
segments.lyrics: She opens a compact. Not makeup. Shoes.
segments.musicCue: Verse 2; kick still late relative to Approved
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Low shot of soot-stained hem and bare feet stepping into black stilettos on a rooftop terrace, velvet rope in the background, ash on the stone, the bouncer's shoes unmoving, cinematic, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 22-second low shot. She steps in. Photoreal.

segments.label: Inside like Tuesday
segments.onScreen: Handful of patrons dancing under a dull mirrorball as if it were Tuesday.
segments.lyrics: Nobody inside is dancing like it's the last night. / They are dancing like it's Tuesday.
segments.musicCue: Bridge; dull mirrorball click, not sparkle
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Interior nightclub: handful of beautifully dressed people dancing under a dull mirrorball as if it were Tuesday, torn couture, no panic, burning city visible through the windows, photoreal, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Approved on the click
segments.onScreen: Stiletto hits stone one beat after Approved. He does not smile.
segments.lyrics: Approved — / The click is the stamp. / The fire is not my department.
segments.musicCue: Kick lands on the click, one beat late
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Close-up of a stiletto heel hitting stone one beat after the bouncer's mouth finishes the word Approved, velvet rope, orange skyline, he does not smile, cinematic, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 23-second close. Kick late on the click. Photoreal.
